name: kit-forge
description: The IP/PII gate plus the kit assembler. ip_pii_linter + kit_assembler (with guard_origins built in) + kit_doctor (verify/install/registry, 6 stages: detect/prereqs/profile/configure/wire-suggest/smoke) + guard_origins + wire_settings + install_git_hook + skill_lint + tools/browse.py (interactive marketplace menu), single exit contract (0 ok/no-op, 1 warn, 2 block, 3 error). No --skip-lint.
